investigations.summary: PMM-T1091 failed on all 10 Nightly E2E lanes: percona/pmm#5730 (PMM-14956) adds the 'PMM Server' alert-rule folder ('PMM High Availability' too in HA), which Grafana lists on the dashboards page; the test now expects them (reproduced on CHAOS, fix 3/3 green).

Docker upgrade 3.8.0->3.10.0 grafana-log check caught 'can't read alerting provisioning files', which percona/pmm#5730 documents as expected when Grafana starts before pmm-managed creates the directory; the check now ignores that exact line (reproduced on CHAOS).

39 alerting tests fail deleting rule groups PMM now provisions (percona/pmm#5730, 'request affects resources created via provisioning API'); already fixed by open #1555 / #1566. Jenkins @ia lane likely the same cause but unreadable here (Jenkins MCP not authorized).
HA PMM-T1061 (No plan found) repeats the Oct 5/6 HA failure; fixed by open #1565.
